entryRoom.$comment: Defense review 2026-11-17: a layout must leave attackers a way in. No tile within battle.deployMarginTiles of a building or wall can be deployed on, so buildings spread one tile apart closed the whole map and no raid could bring a warrior (sim/entryRoom.ts). At least `approaches` of the eight compass approaches (map corners and edge midpoints) must have a deployable tile within `tiles`. Checked by place and move, when a village moves to the server and when a device sends its base; never inside a battle.

$commentP301: P3-01 (PAC-01, 2026-11-18): collectorHoursCap 8 -> 24 and raidableUncollectedFraction 0.5 -> 0.25 (with raids.shieldTiers 16/20/24 h): a once-a-day player banked 8 of 24 hours and lost half of it to raids, so the casual Keep 5 -> 6 stretch took 26 days. collectBubbleMinFraction 0.02 -> 0.007 keeps the first collect bubble near ten minutes.
$commentBuildCap: P3-03 (PAC-03, 2026-11-18): the longest any build takes unless a building names its own buildCapSeconds (the Coin Mint, Terraced Farm, Treasury and Storehouse: 4 days, 5 days since Phase 4's rules-8 campaign (regular Keep 15 at day 98 with 4: the gate is 100-140), so economy buildings stop eating three quarters of all builder time; their collectors keep producing while they upgrade). tests/gameplay/sim/data.test.ts reads it.
$commentHeroHall: P4-10 (BNL-11, 2026-11-18): the Hero Hall level each hero needs to be chosen, by unlock order (Shadow Captain, Iron Matriarch, Sky Admiral, Grand Sensei). The Hall never caps a hero's level. SIM_RULES 10 (2026-11-25, hero choice live): the Hall unlocks at Keep 9, when the Iron Matriarch gives a first real choice (level 1); the Sky Admiral needs 3 (Keep 10+, she joins from Keep 11).
$commentGarrisonCrew: P2-14 (2026-11-18): this many defense, trap or support builds at a time take no Village Artisan (sim/village.ts builderStatus), so fortifying does not stop the village growing. Free, never sold: no product, offer or Jade price. The lab's Rules 10 patch used 2.
